review_description: Absolutely satisfied with CKB Solar and Electrical company. Tried to get quotes from solar pumping solutions and they didn't show up many times.

The person that designed the system was the same that installed it. He is a licence electrician and solar installer.I asked him the question from your website plus more and he was always answering and explaining,it was never a problem. I was never made feel bad about asking questions or stupid like with other companies. They came on time and when they said they were coming. I was not pressured to buy at any moment. I will definetly recommend CKB Solar and Electrical Pty Ltd to anyone. I am very very happy that I chose this company.Regard, Ana Maria
